reasons.claim: One chain runs from the compiler's father through six links to the Imam, who answers; the man addressed is not a link.
reasons.quote: عن حماد بن عثمان، عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام أنه قال لرجل

reasons.claim: Three co-transmitters meet at Isma'il, and the dashed remark only gives Ibn Ayyub's wording for the same Isma'il, adding no route.
reasons.quote: جميعا عن إسماعيل بن جعفر، - قال ابن أيوب حدثنا إسماعيل، -

reasons.claim: The chain continues from Isma'il to al-Ala', his father, and Abu Hurayra.
reasons.quote: قال أخبرني العلاء، عن أبيه، عن أبي هريرة

reasons.claim: Ibn Abbas relays what Umm Hani told him, so she is the last link.
reasons.quote: عن ابن عباس، قال حدثتني أم هانئ بنت أبي طالب

reasons.claim: The Imam relays from his father, grandfather and great-grandfather, and the Prophet ends the chain.
reasons.quote: سمعت أبي يحدث، عن أبيه، عن جده عليهم السلام أن رسول الله

reasons.claim: The six transmitters before the Imam stand in the text's order.
reasons.quote: عن يحيى بن المثنى، قال: حدثنا محمد بن أبي طلحة الصيرفي

reviews.question: a source known only by a title (Nawadir al-Hikma) standing before the Imam's saying

reasons.claim: The only named speaker is the Imam, cited from a book named only by its title; if the title is no link the reading is right, and if the owner makes it one it would stand before the Imam.
reasons.quote: فِي نَوَادِرِ اَلْحِكْمَةِ أَنَّ اَلصَّادِقَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ

reviews.uncertainty_note: The title of a cited book is an unruled question.

reasons.claim: One plain chain of six ends at Abu Hurayra, who quotes the Prophet.
reasons.quote: عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة، قال قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: The bare Muhammad is its own link, and the dashed gloss on Uqba adds no link.
reasons.quote: قال حدثنا محمد، قال حدثنا شعبة، عن عقبة، - يعني ابن حريث -

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Ibn Umar, who quotes the Prophet.
reasons.quote: سمعت ابن عمر، يقول قال رسول الله

reasons.claim: The father, then the uncle al-Majishun, are single links in the text's order.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبي، حدثنا عبد العزيز بن أبي سلمة، عن عمه الماجشون بن أبي سلمة

reasons.claim: The chain ends at Ali, who describes the Prophet's practice.
reasons.quote: عن علي بن أبي طالب، - رضى الله عنه - قال كان رسول الله

reasons.claim: Umm Sulaym asks the Prophet and he answers; under ruling 3 the asker is a link, so the chain ends Anas, then Umm Sulaym, with the Prophet ending it.
reasons.quote: عن أنس، أن أم سليم، سألت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

reasons.claim: Both readers left the asker out, treating her as a figure in the scene.
reasons.quote: Umm Sulaym is the asker, not a link

notes: Umm Sulaym asks and the Prophet answers: the asker is a link (ruling 3); the Prophet ends the chain.

reviews.uncertainty_note: Anas tells of her question without saying he heard it from her, so ending at Anas is also possible.

reasons.claim: Hammad, an unnamed informant, Hariz and the Imam stand in this order, and the gap is an unnamed link.
reasons.quote: رَوَى حَمَّادُ بْنُ عِيسَى عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ
